title: Validate physical sizing, touch comfort and text across displays
source: Existing BACKLOG.md QA-002 row; selected with all non-REL-001 work on 2026-11-07.
finding: Physical validation task; no application sizing defect is established.
automated_coverage: tests/android/test_displaymatrix.py reuses native text-fitting and selector endpoint/cold-restart tests at baseline, compact and roomy viewport/logical-density profiles. It records metadata/screenshots/row bounds and verifies restoration of original overrides.
current_work: Completed the native simulation matrix and added opt-in actual Windows monitor rendering/transition coverage. Physical ruler measurements and shopping comfort remain pending.
setup_observation: Compact immediate-release input-swipe setup sometimes did not enter editing, including once after bounded waiting. Three independent held-frame probes visibly armed the pulley and activated editing. Selector setup now uses one requested-1200 ms continuous motion plus exactly 200 ms hold, no retry; the complete compact 26-selector matrix passes. No root cause or application threshold defect is claimed; original failures and a transient missing initial accessibility root are preserved in reviews/QA-002.md.

verification.connected_displays: tests/displays/tst_displays.qml exercises the production window on LG TV SSCR2 (DPR 1) and LG ULTRAFINE (DPR 1.25), both themes and scales 1/2, plus repeated cross-monitor moves at scale 1.5 retaining draft, keyboard and list identity/order/checks. Actual text pixels, fitting, owning screen, reference geometry and render-target DPR are asserted. See out/displays/connected-ctest-final.txt and reviews/QA-002.md; EDID dimensions are not independent ruler measurements.
verification.profiles: Baseline 1440x3120/560, compact 1080x1920/480 and roomy 1440x3120/420 each pass 20 native text records and 26 selector/endpoint/cold-restart records: 138 total. Requested effective wm geometry and both-theme actual screenshot dimensions are verified. Every final run reports restore_matches=true.
verification.controller_regression: tests/android/test_displaymatrix_control.py simulates loss of ADB after configuration begins. It fails the earlier controller snapshot and passes the corrected controller, requiring failed restoration to be recorded and every restoration to be attempted. Before/after reports are out/remaining/matrix-control-before.txt and matrix-control-after.txt.
verification.environment_history: A baseline attempt lost the emulator after host graphics-context/external-memory errors, disconnecting ADB and preventing restoration. It is retained as an invalid environment run, not a pass. The task-owned emulator was restarted and settings reconciled; the fresh final baseline run and cleanup pass.

remaining: Measure physical row geometry on actual independently calibrated displays; five rows have a 46.35 mm design reference.
Assess one-handed comfort and short/long-text readability at normal shopping distance and lighting.
Compare distinct actual display hardware, font/display-size settings and IMEs.
limitations: Changing wm size/density is simulated geometry, not independent physical mm calibration or multi-device usability acceptance. No devicePixelRatio correction, arbitrary tolerance or app density change is authorized by the absence of physical measurements.
closure_criteria: Record actual device settings, ruler measurements and readability/comfort results in reviews/QA-002.md. Distinguish design font size from visible glyph ink.
